description: Bounty-liveness check for one issue: is the advertised bounty backed by a live platform, an unverifiable claim with no named payer, or a dead platform (algora has been dead since 2025 while thousands of issues still wear its labels)? Returns the classification with its evidence. Context for the contributor, never a verdict. Agent-callable surface of `greenlight bounty`.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

name: bounty_check
